notes.title: Update - V1.1.54
notes.content:
This update is to fix some display issues some people having been having:

[b]Windows[/b]

[list]
[*] Fullscreen mode enabled again (via settings)
[*] Content will adjust when resizing window
[/list]

[b]Mac[/b]

[list]
[*] Fullscreen toggle available at any time
[/list]

If you do resize the window in-game, navigate to another page after resizing in order for the UI to adjust. Until we are able to devise a way to safely re-draw the current screen this is best alternative.

notes.title: Patch - v1.1.53
notes.content:
Some people have reported issues with fullscreen mode on Windows. For now I have switched it off until I can solve the problem, which is not easy due to the limited resolution management options in the game engine RFB is built in.

If you launch RFB and cannot see the title bar at the top or tab bar at the bottom, try resizing the window until they are visible, and likewise for the sidebar.

If your monitor has a fairly low resolution and playing in windowed mode makes text too small to read , there is a 'large text' option in settings.

If you still experience issues, please post in the forums with some screenshots and details of your screen resolution, monitor etc.

notes.title: UPDATE - v0.6.9.10
notes.content:
This update introduces the ability to set your captain and set-piece takers on the tactics screen, giving the manager more involvement particularly in the days before subs.

In a future update you will also be able to set these within a player’s profile screen.


[b]CHANGE LIST[/b]

[list]

[*] Added third option 'INDIVIDUAL' to 'View' tab on tactics screen. This will bring up a panel where the the captain and set-piece takers can be set.
[*] Added ability to set the team captain and two understudies. Factors such as ability, age, time at the club and happiness factors will affect the effectiveness of a captain. For example a captain who values money above all else is unlikely to have the respect of all team-mates.
[*] The choice of captain will affect certain attributes positively or negatively during games depending on how respected the captain is.
[*] The choice of captain will also have an affect on your team’s ability to come from behind, again depending on his standing within the squad.
[*] Added ability to choose up to three set-piece takers (six for penalties) for various situations. If you want a player to take all of a certain set-piece, you can set all three slots to the same man (except penalties). Factors such as crossing, creativity, long shots, finishing, technique, decisions and confidence will affect the ability of a set-piece taker, depending on the situation. 
[*] Reduced conversion rate for poor penalty takers
[*] Increased quality of out-swinging corners slightly
[*] Increased quality of direct free-kicks taken on same side as best foot
[*] Prevented injured players who remain on the field from taking corners and free-kicks
[*] Captain denoted in the ratings screen with a 'C' after player's name (only for matches played from this update onwards)


[/list]

[b]ISSUES ACKNOWLEDGED - WORK ONGOING[/b]

[list]
[*] Most non-league clubs will play in red & white. Research ongoing.
[*] If you finish in the re-election/relegation positions and are removed from the league, the game will crash rather than giving a game-over message.
[*] The game is slower on Windows than OSX. We will set aside a few weeks for optimisation soon to improve the speed of the game on Windows.
[/list]

notes.title: UPDATE - v0.6.7.13
notes.content:
This update fixes a potential crash when viewing previous matches and a couple of minor improvements.

Work is progressing well on both AI transfers and other leagues.

notes.title: UPDATE - v0.6.2.10
notes.content:
This patch fixes a number of issues identified through the error logs. 

If you come across a bug or crash which prevents you from continuing your save, please post a bug report on the forums in order for us to give the problem a higher priority. Please make sure you have tried restarting the program and trying again before posting.

Additionally, if you can upload the saved game to Dropbox/Google Drive/Mediafire etc, we’ll be able to track the problem down a lot quicker. See the forum post for more details.

If you notice a problem with a competition, for instance the draw for the next round never happened, or there was an odd number of teams in the draw for a knockout round, please post a bug report containing the season, competition name and round where the problem occured. 

We will continue to work on bug fixes ahead of new features until we are satisfied the game is relatively stable. The sheer scope of the game means that many rare issues do not come to light until the game is played in anger by hundreds of users, each playing through different seasons with different clubs and in a variety of ways.

[b]CHANGE LIST[/b]

[list]
[*] Prevented crash if a previous season's European competition did not complete
[*] Game will log error event if a European competition does not complete
[*] Prevent crash and log error event if a save file could not be backed up
[*] Fixed potential crash when calculating board investment at end of season
[*] Fixed rare crash in ratings & scores screens when going back to match screen
[*] Fixed rare crash when adjusting wage/transfer budget
[*] Reduced negative effect of adjusting budgets (£2 transfers lost for every £1 added to wages)
[*] Fixed transfer budget not being rounded on home screen after adjustment
[*] Prevented user going to a non-existent player profile from tactics screen
[*] Prevented transfer/loan/short lists being drawn twice
[*] Fixed rare crash when sorting squad screen
[*] Prevented rare crash where CPU has no goalkeeper
[*] Fixed rare crash when viewing the squad of a team with a suspended player
[*] Prevented game from hanging when starting second save in same session
[*] Implemented prize money for league and cup performance
[*] Fixed cup draws following a group stage where more than one club per group qualifies
[*] Fixed potential crash when approaching a staff member with maximum experience
[*] Prevented rare crash when player chooses a club to join, error event will be logged
[*] Fixed issue which would sometimes cause the End Season routine to hang after ‘Updating Players’ step

[/list]


[b]ISSUES ACKNOWLEDGED - WORK ONGOING[/b]

[list]
[*] Most non-league clubs will play in red & white. Research ongoing.
[*] Anglo-scottish cup will not correctly split into English/Scottish phases.
[*] The game will continue beyond 1998/99 but this has not been tested fully and you may encounter issues. 
[/list]
